verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no vendor-maintained guide or tool for migrating users off a competing auth provider, and nothing showing password hashes can be imported to avoid forced resets. The custom user-storage provider SPI is a developer building block, and realm JSON import/export only covers Keycloak's own configuration. One community comment that moving from Auth0 was "fairly easy" is anecdotal and does not show first-party migration support.
